newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc ends firm, off highs in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc ends firm, off highs in quiet trade.

text.p: 1515 GMT - The Swiss franc drifted to a quiet close Monday with both U.S. and U.K. markets closed for holidays.
One trader at a large Swiss bank said he saw levels on dollar/Swiss below 1.40 francs as a buying opportunity.
Likewise, he said 82.75 Swiss centimes was likely to be a buying opportunity.
* Dollar ends weaker at 1.4007/4012 Swiss francs versus 1.4064/4069 on Friday.
* Mark ends weaker at 82.94/97 versus 83.28/30 Friday.
